diagnosis.original_evidence: At source HEAD, PeripheralWeight holds 1.0 to 1.20 inclusive and returns 0.0 for >1.20, while R30 applies this weight to both anchor and optical boost.
diagnosis.root_cause: A discontinuous visibility cutoff in exact gameplay HUD peripheral motion rather than an optical FOV or per-eye pose error.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Replace cutoff with bounded C1 smooth outgoing envelope over 1.0..1.2; retain central/plateau behavior and strict nonfinite/outside fallback.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Extend portable C++ smoke and Python source/mutation validator with bidirectional outgoing sweep, boundary and exact neutral cases.
